story.zh: 荆州已平定大半，刘备继续采用诸葛亮的建议，向益州靠拢。
story.en: With most of Jing Province pacified, Liu Bei continues to follow Zhuge Liang's counsel, turning his ambitions toward Yi Province.

trigger.zh: 刘备、关羽、张飞、赵云、诸葛亮、刘璋、张鲁、马超存活。 江夏、江陵属刘备，成都、梓潼、巴郡属刘璋，马超属张鲁。
trigger.en: Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, Liu Zhang, Zhang Lu, and Ma Chao are alive. Jiangxia and Jiangling belong to Liu Bei, Chengdu, Zitong, and Ba Commandery belong to Liu Zhang, Ma Chao belongs to Zhang Lu.

participate.en: 【Belong to the Faction of Liu Bei, Liu Zhang, or Zhang Lu】

defy.zh: 【<刘备势力><非前半部分留守后方的武将>救下庞统，<与张任关系等级至少为2>使张任存活并使其成为家将】
defy.en: 【<Liu Bei's Faction><Officer not stationed in the Rear during the first half> Rescue Pang Tong, <Relationship level with Zhang Ren is at least Level 2> Ensure Zhang Ren survives and recruit him as a Retainer】

force.zh: 刘备身为君主并占领<江陵><江夏>
force.en: Liu Bei is Ruler and occupies <Jiangling><Jiangxia>

force.zh: 刘璋身为君主并占领<成都><梓潼><巴郡>

force.zh: 张鲁身为君主并占领<汉中>

force.en: Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang, and Pang Tong return to Liu Bei's Faction.

force.zh: 张松、法正、张任、泠苞回归刘璋势力
force.en: Zhang Song, Fa Zheng, Zhang Ren, and Ling Bao return to Liu Zhang's Faction.
